faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about BikinStiker
faq.a1: BikinStiker is an AI-powered app that lets you create custom stickers from text prompts. Describe what you want, and our AI generates unique stickers you can share anywhere.
faq.a2: BikinStiker is currently free: Free gets 5 credits per month and Plus gets 50 credits per month. Plus ($2.99/month) and Pro ($5.99/month) paid plans are on the roadmap — prices may change.
faq.a3: You earn credits from monthly grants, daily missions like sharing the app, generating stickers, daily check-ins and streaks, plus optional rewarded ads. Sharing via your share link can earn bonus credits.
faq.a4: Yes! Your sticker packs are stored locally on your device, so you can access and use them even without an internet connection.
faq.a5: Your prompts and generated stickers are processed securely. We do not sell your personal data. See our Privacy Policy for full details.
faq.q6: How do I upgrade or cancel?
faq.a6: The app is currently free with no app-store billing. Paid plans are roadmap; when launched you will manage them via the app or your app-store account.
